sentences.en: A summary of his speech was printed in the newspaper.
sentences.zh: 他的演讲摘要刊登在了报纸上。

sentences.en: This page is not nicely printed so print it again.
sentences.zh: 这个页面打印得不太好看，请重新打印。

sentences.en: Dan printed thousands of pages of articles from the Internet.
sentences.zh: 丹从互联网打印了成千上万篇文章的页面。

senses.zh: 印刷的；印花样的；已印好的
